policy.accepted_result_rule: Only repository-frozen acceptance/evidence records may support numerical conclusions in the canonical paper.
policy.project_defined_rule: Project-selected parameters, tolerances, QA gates and study designs must remain labelled project-defined.
policy.source_gated_rule: Source-gated physics may be described as unresolved or future work, but not promoted to completed results.
policy.in_progress_rule: A workflow run without reviewed/frozen acceptance evidence remains in-progress even if raw computation succeeds.
